text_block_list.text:
Starting today, we would finally begin 
full-scale training for Haru Urara's 
Twinkle Series challenge.

Haru Urara is also very eager to win the 
first place. I'm sure she will work hard 
enough.
—Or at least that's what I thought…

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it's the trainer! Starting today, I'm 
counting on you!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I'm good at doing my best, so leave 
it to me!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Yay! I'll run a lot!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Eh-ho, eh-ho, eh-ho! Phew, the first round 
is over!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Ye—

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Ohhhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
A butterfly! It's a big one with a pretty 
pattern!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Look, look, over there! It's fluttering 
across the grass!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Ah, it's going away! Wait, don't go!

Haru Urara ran at full speed. I thought 
about going after her, but maybe she has 
something in mind.

Trusting her, I decided to wait a little 
longer…

……… She hasn't come back at all! Maybe 
something happened… I must hurry to find 
her!
(She's not here…)
(Not here, either!)
(Same here!)
After searching around, finally―

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Pheeeew, I'm so tired! Let's take a 
break～!

I found Haru Urara! What's more, she's 
covered in mud… Did something happen after 
all?!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Huh? Trainer! What a coincidence!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Did the trainer come here to chase after 
the fish, too?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Hm?

―According to the story, Haru Urara, after 
chasing the butterfly, reached the 
riverbed and started chasing the fish.

I'm not quite sure about it… but maybe it 
was Haru Urara's way of training.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
You know, there was one that looked like 
the king of the river! I was so close to 
catching it～!

… I think she was just playing around 
after all.
choice_data_list: Come on, let's get back to training.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Hmm? Were we training?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Hmmm, I guess we were doing it, but I 
didn't feel like we were…

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Aah! There was a big fish just now! Isn't 
that the king?! Let's look together!
choice_data_list: … You want to win first place, right?
… You want to win first place, right?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Of course! Because winning looks like a 
lot of fun!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I want to run a lot, win a lot, and have a 
lot of fun!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
That's why you became my trainer after 
all!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I'm looking forward to working with you 
from now on! *Bow*

After all, Haru Urara has the will to do 
her best. As long as she can keep that up, 
her goal of getting first place will 
definitely come true, but…

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it's a carrot cloud! It looks 
delicious～! Ah, wait, don't go～!

… It looks like I'll need to think about 
how to get her to focus on her training 
first.

In any case, my days of training with Haru 
Urara have begun!
